title: Affine pullbacks of perfect complexes detect isomorphisms
statement: Let $g:X'\to X$ be an affine morphism of quasi-compact quasi-separated schemes [def-pc-scheme], and let $\varphi:A\to B$ be a morphism in $D_{QCoh}(X')$ [def-pc-derived-category]. Suppose for every perfect $M\in D_{QCoh}(X)$ [def-pc-perfect-complex] and all integers $m,n$ the map $\operatorname{Hom}(Lg^*M[m],A[n])\to\operatorname{Hom}(Lg^*M[m],B[n])$ induced by $\varphi[n]$ is bijective [def-pc-derived-pullback]. Then $\varphi$ is an isomorphism.

proof.text: Choose a perfect generator on X; its affine pullback detects zero objects on X prime.
The quasi-coherent property is triangulated. Complete the underlying morphism to a distinguished triangle whose third term Z is quasi-coherent.

For each shifted pulled-back generator Q[m], injectivity of Hom(Q[m],phi[1]) makes t composed with the third triangle arrow zero. Exactness makes t factor through the second triangle term; surjectivity at shift zero and zero composition of the first two triangle arrows then make t zero.
The pulled-back generator makes Z zero; a distinguished triangle with zero third term has invertible first arrow. The fully faithful inclusion reflects invertibility.

theorem affinePullbackPerfect_detects_iso
    [∀ Z : Scheme.{u},
      HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Z.toRingedSpace))]
    {X X' : Scheme.{u}}
    [CompactSpace X] [QuasiSeparatedSpace X]
    [CompactSpace X'] [QuasiSeparatedSpace X']
    [∀ U : X.Opens,
      HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).over U))]
    (g : X' ⟶ X) [IsAffineHom g]
    {A B : schemeDerivedQCohCategory X'} (φ : A ⟶ B)
    (htest : ∀ (M : schemeDerivedQCohCategory X), Scheme.IsPerfect X M.obj →
      ∀ m n : ℤ, Function.Bijective
        (fun t : ((derivedPullback g).obj M.obj)⟦m⟧ ⟶ A.obj⟦n⟧ ↦ t ≫ φ.hom⟦n⟧')) :
    IsIso φ
